subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: Which PR should establish the shared MS Teams SharePoint timeout contract before the other branch is rebased to reuse it?
rationale: Both PRs fix distinct user-visible hangs but modify the same owner and policy, so merge order determines the final compatibility contract and requires an explicit integration choice.

options.title: Land this helper first
options.body: Merge this PR after its exact-head checks pass, then rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104120 to reuse the landed helper without redefining it.

options.title: Land file consent first
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104120 first, then rebase this PR and retain only its Graph and SharePoint call-site changes and tests.

options.title: Consolidate both fixes
options.body: Replace the overlapping branches with one combined patch covering both upload paths and one shared timeout contract.

recommendation.title: Land this helper first
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after its exact-head checks pass, then rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104120 to reuse the landed helper without redefining it.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied tracker connects this person to broader MS Teams delivery and lifecycle work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the integration choice.
